只有左边走到平移副本: Only the left reaches a translated copy
只有右边走到平移副本: Only the right reaches a translated copy
两边都回到原坐标: Both return to the starting coordinates
坐标和位移采用 BC 原胞的分数坐标，波矢采用同一原胞的倒易分数坐标。整数位移表: Positions and displacements use fractional coordinates in the BC primitive cell. Wavevectors use the reciprocal fractional coordinates of the same cell. Integer displacements translate between cells.
每组取同一个二重旋转部分。: Use the same twofold rotation part for both groups.
每组取同一个镜面反射部分。: Use the same reflection part for both groups.
从同一个点出发，连续作用两次。哪一边到达不同晶胞中的同一对应位置？: Start at the same point and apply each operation twice. Which side lands at the corresponding position in another cell?
预测正确。请比较两边第二步的原胞平移。: Correct. Compare the cell translations left after the second step.
再看两边第二步的坐标。整数分量的差说明它们落在哪一个晶胞。: Check the coordinates after the second step. Their integer difference shows how the two endpoints are displaced between cells.
第二步留下的原胞平移: Cell translation after the second step
平移在当前波矢的相位: Translation phase at the selected wavevector
沿平移方向的波矢分量: Wavevector component along the translation direction
核对预测并显示两次作用: Check the prediction and show both steps
空间群操作暂时无法读取，请重试。: The space-group operations could not be loaded. Please try again.
后作用的分数位移: Fractional translation of the later operation
先作用的位移再经过后操作的旋转: Earlier translation transformed by the later linear part
目录中同线性部分的代表元位移: Catalogue representative translation for the same linear part
完整位移、代表元位移和差值: Full translation, representative translation and their difference
完整复合等于先作用目录代表元，再平移整数向量。: The full product applies the catalogue representative first and then translates by an integer vector.
两个因子都把当前波矢保持到相差一个倒易格矢。可以在这个波矢上读取平移因子。: Both factors preserve the wavevector up to reciprocal lattice vectors. The translation factor applies within this wavevector sector.
至少一个因子把当前波矢变到不同的倒易等价类。上面的相位是整数平移对当前波矢的作用: At least one factor takes the wavevector to a different reciprocal equivalence class. The phase above is the action of the integer translation at the selected wavevector.
从同一个点开始，逐次作用先执行的操作，直到线性部分首次回到恒等。: Start at the same point and repeat the first operation until its linear part first returns to the identity.
把空间群和波矢带到计算中心 →: Open this group and wavevector in the calculation center →
试做任意空间群的精确复合: Compose operations in any space group
从 230 个普通空间群中选一个。两次操作按先后顺序作用在同一个点上。: Choose one of the 230 ordinary space groups. Apply two operations in order to a single point.
计算这两个操作的复合: Calculate the product of these two operations
